notes: 100-point rubric for an X profile. Each check names the profile fields it needs. A field that is missing from the input means 'not provided', and the check is not scored. A field that is present but empty (for example 'bio:' with nothing after it) means the profile has none, and the check scores 0. audit.py implements every check id below; edit points, descriptions and fixes freely, but keep the ids.

checks.desc: 60 to 160 characters (160 is X's limit)
checks.fix: Write a bio of 60 to 160 characters: who you help, with what, and one proof point.

checks.desc: Says what you do or who you help
checks.fix: Lead the bio with what you do and for whom, e.g. 'I help early-stage founders write landing pages that convert.'

checks.desc: No empty labels (passionate, guru, enthusiast, visionary...)
checks.fix: Swap labels like 'passionate' or 'guru' for one concrete fact about your work.

checks.desc: Contains a proof point: a number, a product or a named result
checks.fix: Add one proof point to the bio: a number, a product you built, or a result you got.

checks.desc: At most 2 hashtags and 3 emoji
checks.fix: Cut the bio down to at most 2 hashtags and 3 emoji so the words carry it.

checks.desc: A post is pinned
checks.fix: Pin your best post: the one that shows a new visitor what they get by following you.

checks.desc: First line lands in 100 characters without filler
checks.fix: Rewrite the pinned post's first line as a hook under 100 characters (see x-post).

checks.desc: Pinned within the last 180 days
checks.fix: Refresh the pinned post; one older than 6 months usually no longer shows your best work.

checks.desc: Ends with an ask: a question, a link or a follow reason
checks.fix: End the pinned post with one clear ask: follow for X, read Y, or reply with Z.

checks.desc: Handle is 12 characters or fewer (15 is X's limit)
checks.fix: Consider a shorter handle; short handles are easier to remember and mention.

checks.desc: No digit strings and at most one underscore
checks.fix: Drop digit strings and extra underscores from the handle if you can.

checks.desc: Display name has a readable name or brand, 50 characters max
checks.fix: Use your real name or brand in the name field, optionally with a short niche keyword.

checks.desc: At most 2 emoji and not all caps
checks.fix: Trim the name field to at most 2 emoji and normal capitalisation.

checks.desc: A custom banner is set
checks.fix: Upload a banner (1500x500); the default empty header looks unfinished.

checks.desc: Banner states your promise or shows proof
checks.fix: Put one line on the banner that says what you post about, or show your product or proof.

checks.desc: 3 or more posts a week across the recent posts given
checks.fix: Post at least 3 times a week at a pace you can keep; x-plan can build the week.

checks.desc: 60% or more of recent posts are on your niche
checks.fix: Keep most recent posts on your niche so new visitors see what you are about.

checks.desc: Bio lists 3 or fewer roles or topics
checks.fix: Cut the bio to one main identity; a list of 5 roles says 'no focus'.

checks.desc: Pinned post is about the same thing as the bio
checks.fix: Pin a post about the topic your bio promises, so the two back each other up.

checks.desc: Name or bio uses one of your niche keywords
checks.fix: Put your main niche keyword in the name or bio so people searching for it find you.

checks.desc: Profile has a link
checks.fix: Add a link to the one place you want visitors to go: newsletter, product or site.

checks.desc: Bio tells visitors what to do next
checks.fix: End the bio with a short ask that points at the link, e.g. 'Free weekly teardown below'.

checks.desc: Link goes somewhere other than X itself
checks.fix: Point the link off X; linking to another X page wastes the one link slot.
